title: Capability table
description: contracts/capabilities.json (spec-001 §5–6, adr-001 D3, REQ-INT-03): each capability with the minimum WingFoil version it needs and the project conditions under which it applies. minVersion null = in no released WingFoil version (always read-only). A capability whose conditions do not all hold for a project is hidden.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id; the web catalogue key is capability.<id>.

name.description: English name (README, logs); the UI uses the catalogue.

minVersion.description: Lowest WingFoil version that provides it (exact semantic version), or null when no released version does.

via.description: How the server provides it at minVersion (a CLI command or a direct read), null when it does not yet.

replacedBy.description: What replaces the current source in a later WingFoil.

conditions.description: Project-condition ids that must all hold for the capability to apply (e.g. a remote); none in v0.1.
